models.model: Claude (creator-reported; director, story, prompts, review, edit)
Codex image generation (creator-reported; character sheets and first/last frames)
Seedance 2.0 mini or 2.5 (creator-reported; frames to video)

requirements: Claude Code as the director, with Codex installed for images; FFmpeg and Python for the edit.
A Volcengine (Volcano Ark) account and ARK_API_KEY for Seedance, paid per second of video: about ¥0.5/s for 2.0 mini or ¥1.5/s for 2.5 at 720p, per the prompt.

preview.description: Escape, a 138-second hand-drawn-style 2D animated short: Claude Code directs, Codex paints every shot's first and last frames, Seedance animates them in 5-second clips, and Claude edits with code. 20+ clips, one reshoot.
